newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek stocks slip on low volume, weak construction.
newsitem.headline: Greek stocks slip on low volume, weak construction.

text.p: Tuesday's trading in the Athens bourse was spiced by fairly active block trading but the general index edged back with construction leading the market lower despite a mixed view on banks and industrials.

"We are at the peak of the summer holiday season, don't expect anything other than range trading and low volumes," said a floor trader. "Only some of the block trades executed represent underlying demand, the rest is just put-through orders for book entries."
Construction stocks were weak today on continuing concern over bank debts of a large number of stocks in the sector following liquidity problems in Atemke, the trader added.
The Athens general index slipped 0.12 percent or 1.94 points lower to 1,584.91 from Monday's 1,586.85 close, fluctuating between 1,580 and 1,590 points.
Construction lost 1.90 percent against a fairly mixed background in other sectors. Banks were down 0.10 percent and industrials gained 0.24 percent.
Turnover was a light 9.1 billion drachmas on volume of 3.6 million shares.
